title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK) Policy & Guidelines

nodes.title: 1. Programme Overview & Type
nodes.content:
Programme Name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
Jurisdiction: India
Category: Maternal and newborn healthcare entitlements
Type: Public Healthcare Entitlement
Details: Entitlements intended to provide free/cashless services for pregnant women and sick newborns/infants in public institutions, according to guidelines.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria & Conditions
nodes.content:
Eligibility: Pregnant women and sick newborns/infants covered by current JSSK rules; confirm exact scope from national/state guidance.
Individual Enrolment Required: False

nodes.title: 3. Required Documents & Documentation
nodes.content: Required Documents: Pregnancy/MCP card or child health records and identity/facility records where available. Confirm local requirements.

nodes.title: 4. Application Procedure & Access Desks
nodes.content:
Where to Apply / Access: Access services at eligible government health facilities; contact facility help desk, ANM or ASHA.
Official Portal: https://nhm.gov.in/
